summary.text: Brian Armas is the Republican candidate for Arkansas House of Representatives District 8 in the November 3, 2026 general election; no other candidate is listed for the seat.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a three-term Benton County Justice of the Peace who works in marketing and campaigns on limited government, lower taxes and reduced regulation.

paragraphs.text: Brian Armas earned a high school diploma from Pine Tree High School, and his career experience includes working in marketing.
He has been affiliated with Lightfly Creative, LLC.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Armas said he has been a resident of Northwest Arkansas for 25 years, lives on a farm with his wife Kara, and has owned small businesses for more than a decade.

He listed property rights and regulatory reform, small business, education and parental rights, and fiscal responsibility among his policy interests, and said he supports the Second Amendment and opposes abortion.
